trajectory.thought: The leader (a10, weighted w=w1) is a seeded baseline and the runner-up margin is only 0.00375 with an "indistinguishable" verdict. action_args.justification: The series is trend-dominated with weak seasonality, unstable model ranking (Kendall tau 0.064), and high error correlation (mean 0.905, only 2 independent groups). With only 3 validation windows, weight estimation is high-variance and the near-uniform weighted combination (w1, concentration 0.024) already captures the robust signal. The runner-up (plain mean) is statistically indistinguishable, confirming that no subset or alternative combination kind offers a reliable edge over this near-uniform blend.
